answer: Budget it in hours. Honest work is 2 hours per answer. Attacking one seat needs 3 reciprocal attestations, 3 auditor slots, and 200 POA locked for 30 days, about 9 hours of coordination plus the float. The cheapest attack costs 4.5x honest work, and a mesa of fake seats only pays if that ratio inverts. A thread of reciprocity runs through every panel, and the dawn audit finds the seats that never gave one. Cost per captured vote, 9 hours and 200 POA.
